issues.what: The 'harness GO definition' of the top-1% pass item is one of several defensible translations of harness.metrics' diff_top1_removed (a pooled 99th-percentile cut over ONE net on disjoint kept/skipped units) to the paired policy-vs-Foundation setting, and the FINDINGS present the chosen one as 'the harness definition' without disclosing the choice. The item is within a few INR of zero on 1 min under every translation and flips sign for learner B under the harness-literal one, so the reader should know it is fragile. Verdict unaffected: SPA fails for every learner on both timeframes and B also fails the CPCV item.
issues.where: studies/exit_policy/05_evaluate.py line 84 (diff_top1_winners_removed = d[net < quantile(net, 0.99)].mean()); FINDINGS.md line 19 (section 1 pass rule) and section 11.2 (lines 277-296); harness.py lines 261-262 (top = quantile(net[rows], 0.99) over all units, kept and skipped both cut)

On 5 min: literal -122.22 / 49.23 / -40.62 / -19.35 vs study -76.62 / 95.24 / -20.49 / -149.14 (same signs for C_nested, C_best_is, B). The diffs themselves are 86.57 / 104.84 / 100.8 / 37.56.
issues.fix: Add one sentence to FINDINGS section 11.2 (and findings.json caveats) stating that the paired setting admits several translations of the harness item, naming the one used (policy net's own top 1%, paired mean) and giving the harness-literal value beside it (1 min: C_nested 4.50, B -2.67), so the reader sees the item sits within a few INR of zero on 1 min under any translation; no rerun and no verdict change needed.
